Comparator provenance is not explicit overall: HAN document BLEU is recomputed from supplied outputs, and some baselines are trained by the authors, but provenance of the dated XLM/MASS/BART scores is unclear; rerun and scores_copied remain NR. CC25 sources, language sizes and sampling rule are given, but exact crawl selection is not specified, so data disclosure is conservatively PARTIAL. Corpus token statistics and training steps/batch size are not an explicitly reported total of consumed pre-training tokens. Compute includes 256 V100 GPUs and approximately 2.5 weeks. mBART extends acknowledged BART to multilingual pre-training; this is not coded as renaming an unchanged existing technique.
